description: The number of involutions of n objects with exactly k fixed points. It is 0 when n-k is odd. For n = 5 and k = 1 the count is 15, and for n = 5 and k = 5 it is 1. n runs from 0 to 100, and k runs from 0 to n. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/involution-fixed
